thread.title: Matt Gress shares endorsements and personal milestones in recent tweets

author: k. k. santos
title: Matt Gress shares endorsements and personal milestones in recent tweets
text:
Matt Gress, a Republican member of the Arizona State House representing the 4th House District since 2023, recently shared updates and personal reflections on his Twitter account.
On June 21, 2026, Gress posted a Father’s Day message acknowledging several father figures in his life. He wrote, “Happy Father’s Day to my dad, Vern; my stepdad, Jim; and my fathers-in-law, Frank and Tom. I’ve been blessed by the example each has set through their love, wisdom, hard work, and commitment to family. Wishing all the dads, grandfathers, stepdads, and father figures out there a https://t.co/3p72Lz9mpV”.
Two days later on June 22, Gress announced an endorsement from a major business organization in Arizona. In his post, he stated: “Honored to receive the endorsement of the Arizona Chamber of Commerce and Industry (@AZChamber). The Chamber cited my record as a “strong pro-business advocate” and my commitment to “free-market policies that stimulate economic growth and prosperity for all Arizonans.” I https://t.co/cDxak0Ue6x”.
On June 24, Gress highlighted his ongoing relationship with former Governor Jan Brewer. He wrote, “Always great to spend time with Governor Jan Brewer (@GovBrewer). We recently grabbed dinner and caught up on Arizona, politics, and life. One thing hasn’t changed—she never misses a beat! Thank you, Governor, for your friendship and continued leadership. https://t.co/4y5PsfcXkf”.
Gress was elected to the Arizona State House in 2023 after replacing previous state representative Joel Joh. As an officeholder for District 4 in Arizona’s legislature—a district covering parts of Phoenix—he has positioned himself as an advocate for pro-business policies while maintaining public engagement through social media platforms.
